_comment: Wiring for cost-budget-guard.py. Two events: PreToolUse is the HARD tier (denies sub-agent dispatch once over budget; finish-and-verify stays open), UserPromptSubmit is the WARN advisory. The ceiling is declared via env on the command (COSTGUARD_SESSION_TOKENS). With no ceiling declared the guard is inert (fail-open). COSTGUARD_PRICE_MAP is optional and only feeds the $-estimate in the advisory. A per-session sidecar cost-budget.json 'budget_tokens' overrides the env ceiling (the seam an orchestrator writes a per-node budget into).
